info.description: Castglo - Investor-ready casting marketplace backend API documentation

CastingCallRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a casting call. Supports extended project schema including roles, talent scope, metadata, media, and add-ons.

GuardianConsent.description: Required for talent profiles where user is under 18 (Section 1E)

EmergencyContact.description: Emergency contact — required for all talent profiles (Section 1E)

MediaSection.description: All media assets attached to a profile (Section 4)

post.description:
Verify a Google ID token and return a Castglo JWT.
- If the email already exists, the Google account is linked to that profile.
- If the email is new, a verified account is created automatically.
- `role` is optional. Defaults to `talent` if omitted; users can update it on their profile later.

idToken.description: The Google ID token received from the frontend Google Sign-In SDK

role.description: Optional role for new users — can be updated on their profile later

isNewUser.description: true if this is the first sign-in (account was just created)

400.description: Missing or invalid idToken / invalid role

post.summary: Set a local password for Google-authenticated accounts (enable dual auth)
post.description:
Allows users who signed up via Google to also enable email/password login.
Once set, users can sign in with either Google **or** their email + password.
This endpoint is only available to accounts that have a linked Google ID.
Users with strictly local accounts should use `/change-password` instead.

200.description: Password set — dual auth (Google + local) now enabled

400.description: Passwords do not match, too short, or account has no Google link

post.summary: Skip moderation and publish immediately (Instant Post)

post.description: Creates a new CastingProfile document linked to the authenticated user. Only one profile may exist per user — returns 400 if one already exists. System-only fields (verifiedBadge, completedCastings, activeCallsCount) are stripped server-side and cannot be set via this route.

400.description: Casting profile already exists or validation error

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's casting profile

patch.summary: Update the authenticated user's casting profile
patch.description: Accepts the same body as POST /casting/profile (all fields optional for partial update). System fields (verifiedBadge, completedCastings, activeCallsCount) are stripped server-side — they cannot be self-assigned via this endpoint. Accepts snake_case keys — they are normalised to camelCase server-side.

schema.description: Partial update — any subset of the fields accepted by POST /casting/profile. All fields are optional for updates.

Supports the full lead capture structure including nested
`basicDetails`, `joiningAs`, role-specific detail objects, and
consent. Only `basicDetails.fullName` and `basicDetails.email`
are strictly required.

get.description:
Returns the full Castglo plan catalogue.
Filter by role using the optional `role` query parameter.

**Plan categories:**
- `talent` — Free, Basic (£4.99/mo), Pro (£9.99/mo)
- `casting_director` — Free, Basic (£29/mo), Pro (£79/mo)
- `industry_professional` — Free, Basic (£7.99/mo), Pro (£19.99/mo)
- `agency` — Agency (£99/mo)
- `enterprise` — Enterprise (custom)

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter plans to a specific user role / category

post.description: Receives and processes Stripe events (checkout completed, subscription updated/deleted, payment succeeded).

Initiates a Stripe Checkout flow for the given plan.
Returns a `url` that the client should redirect to for payment.
The free plan cannot be checked out — it is assigned automatically on registration.

400.description: Validation error (missing planName, invalid plan key)

get.description: Returns plan key, plan name, category, price, currency, billing cycle and next renewal date.
Returns the complete subscription document including usage counters and feature snapshot.

For **Talent** users — returns applications remaining this month.
For **Casting Director** users — returns listings remaining this month.
For **Agency/Enterprise** — indicates unlimited access.

listingsLeft.description: null means unlimited or not applicable

post.description:
Updates the plan on the subscription record.

Cancels the Stripe subscription and marks it as cancelled in the database.
